note: Single style bible for every generated illustration (owner decision 2026-10-08). Changing this file changes prompts and therefore prompt hashes; already-approved art stays approved until regenerated.
style: Original black-and-white pen-and-ink illustration for HERALDRY SKIRMISH: THE DYING LANDS, a grim, clean dark-fantasy medieval tabletop skirmish rulebook. Every image in the book is drawn by the same single illustrator with one consistent technique: confident dip-pen contour lines of varied weight, controlled parallel hatching and crosshatching for all shading, occasional stippling, a few solid black shadow masses, and generous untouched paper-white negative space. Pure black ink on pure white paper only: no grey wash, no gradients, no colour, no paper texture. Light falls from the upper left. Grounded, weathered, believable anatomy, armour, clothing, masonry and materials.
exclusions: No lettering, captions, labels, numbers, signature, logo, watermark, border, frame, panel box, colour, grey wash, airbrush gradient, photorealism, 3D render, anime or cartoon style, tiled pattern, faint grid, parchment or paper texture. Do not imitate any named artist.
reference_instruction: The attached reference images define the illustrator's line weight, hatching density, contrast and finish. Match that technique exactly, but do not copy their subjects or compositions.

cover.framing: Cinematic scene with a clear focal group; open white sky in the upper third for typeset title; vignette edges that fade to white paper.

chapter.framing: Wide establishing scene; horizon in the lower third; vignette edges that fade irregularly to white paper; no rectangular edge.

world.framing: Small landscape or scene vignette; edges fade irregularly to white paper.

climate.framing: Landscape vignette that captures the climate's defining terrain and danger; edges fade irregularly to white paper.

bastion.framing: Town or fortress seen from its approach road; edges fade irregularly to white paper.

ancestry.framing: Single full-length figure, three-quarter view, standing on a small patch of ground; isolated on white.

background.framing: Small emblematic vignette of one figure or the tools of their trade; isolated on white.

class.framing: Single full-length adventurer in an action-ready pose with class-typical arms and gear; isolated on white.

monster.framing: Single creature, full body, three-quarter view, standing on a small patch of ground; isolated on white; a figure for scale only if the text implies it.

item.framing: Still-life arrangement of the described objects on white; no table or background.

tradition.framing: Small emblematic vignette of a caster or the visible effect of the magic; isolated on white.

scenario.framing: Small scene vignette of the scenario's key place and threat at the moment of action; edges fade irregularly to white paper.

campaign.framing: Small interior or architectural vignette of the described stronghold room; edges fade irregularly to white paper.

price_per_mtok_usd.note: Estimates from the published Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) rates; Google's billing console is authoritative.

size_words.L: Large: roughly twice a human's height or bulk
size_words.H: Huge: towering many times a human's size
